notes: §1985:IX.4.7.2 prints START file-name-1 [ KEY { IS EQUAL TO | IS = | IS GREATER THAN | IS > | IS NOT LESS THAN | IS NOT < | IS GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO | IS >= } data-name-1 ] [ INVALID KEY imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT INVALID KEY imperative-statement-2 ] [ END-START ]. startStatement and startKeyPhrase parse it, KeyedIoBinder.BindStart binds the key and operator (EQUAL when KEY is omitted), and the 1985 edition reaches VersionConformancePass, which cuts the operator set to the printed eight (VisitStartKeyPhrase refuses LESS, <, NOT GREATER, LESS OR EQUAL, <=; BindStart refuses NOT EQUAL and NOT = with COBOL0862; VisitComparisonOperator refuses <>), refuses FIRST/LAST and WITH LENGTH (COBOL0900), and now refuses NOT INVALID KEY before INVALID KEY through VisitConditionalPhrases and ConditionalPhraseAssociation.OutOfPrintedOrder (COBOL0900, the landed fix of kb/Work PB5158), the one arm the prior read found missing. Probed at --std 85: (b) all eight printed operators compile and position correctly (EQUAL, =, NOT LESS, NOT <, >=, GREATER OR EQUAL at K001; GREATER and > at K002); the reversed phrase order, INVALID KEY twice, KEY with no operator, IS = with no KEY word, AT END and a literal operand are refused; (c) LESS, <, NOT GREATER, LESS OR EQUAL, <=, NOT EQUAL, NOT =, <>, NOT >=, FIRST and WITH LENGTH are refused; (d) a qualified key positions, a subscripted item (SR4) and a working-storage item (SR6) are refused; (e) DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access run, RANDOM is refused, an absent key gives INV 23, a START with no KEY phrase positions at EQUAL, and a START of a closed file prints status 47 with neither phrase run. The witness runs EQUAL TO, >= and GREATER THAN in the printed order with END-START. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5158 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-06.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-06-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 indexed START: START file-name-1 [KEY {IS EQUAL TO | = | GREATER | > | NOT LESS | NOT < | GREATER OR EQUAL | >=} data-name-1] [INVALID KEY] [NOT INVALID KEY] [END-START]. §2023:14.9.41.2 adds FIRST, LAST, record-key-name-1 and WITH LENGTH arithmetic-expression-1, and lets the INVALID KEY phrases appear in either order; §2023:14.9.41.3 SR3 admits any relational operator of the general relation "with the exception of the relational operators 'IS NOT EQUAL TO' or 'IS NOT='", i.e. the §2023:8.7.5.1 set including LESS, NOT GREATER and LESS OR EQUAL. 1985 STARTs keep their meaning. §2023:14.9.41.4 GR9 does not belong: it speaks of the "relative record number" and governs relative files.
